headline: Router metrics gain verb label and a separate watch gauge
reason: Adds a new metric, changes the histogram label set and registers a new collector, which changes exported series that dashboards and alerts consume.
summary: newRouterMetrics now registers a grafana_router_longrunning_requests gauge by group and adds a verb label to the duration histogram. Existing series change shape, so queries on the old group/status_code labels need updating. In-flight and duration help text now says watches are excluded.
focus: dashboards and alerts that use http_request_duration_seconds without the verb label
that the verb label value set is bounded, since requestVerb falls back to the lowercased HTTP method
MustRegister of the new collector does not collide with another registration of the same name

issues.title: Verb label can take arbitrary client-chosen values
issues.evidence: WithLabelValues(metricGroup, verb, strconv.Itoa(rec.status)) with verb from requestVerb: `return strings.ToLower(req.Method)`
issues.failure_scenario: A client sends requests with arbitrary HTTP method tokens (e.g. FOO1, FOO2, ...) to a known group. If the request info factory leaves the lowercased method as the verb, each distinct method creates a new histogram series, growing memory without bound. The package notes say unknown groups are collapsed to 'unknown' to prevent exactly this.
